definitions.explanation: A route or path for traveling from one place to another.
A course of action or the proper way of doing something.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まっすぐ→まっすぐ：00866_massugu⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please go straight down this road.

examples.japanese: {道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}いました→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.notes: 道に迷う = to lose one's way

notes:
{道|みち} has both literal (road/path) and metaphorical (way/method) meanings.

KANJI READINGS:
- みち: standalone word or native compounds
- どう: Sino-Japanese compounds (martial arts, disciplines)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {道|みち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷|まよ}う→迷う：02426_mayou⟧: to lose one's way
- {道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to ask for directions
- {道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}る→渡る：02441_wataru⟧: to cross the road
- {道|みち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧: to open a path (also figurative)

COMPOUNDS WITH どう:
- ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧: tea ceremony (the way of tea)
- ⟦{柔道|じゅうどう}→柔道：01612_juudou⟧: judo (the gentle way)
- ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧: calligraphy (the way of writing)
- ⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧: martial arts

METAPHORICAL USES:
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道|みち}: the path to success
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{道|みち}: one's own path in life
